briefs.body:
# Market brief — Tuesday 2026-09-22 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Tue 2026-09-22**
- 10:00 ET — Richmond Fed Manufacturing Index (Sep) — regional factory pulse
- ~10:05/10:20/13:00 ET — Williams / Jefferson / Barkin speeches — FOMC voting members

**Wed 2026-09-23**
- no major prints

**Thu 2026-09-24**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims (week of Sep 19) — labor softness check
- 08:30 ET — Current Account (Q2) — external balance
- 10:00 ET — New Home Sales (Aug) — housing demand

**Fri 2026-09-25**
- 08:30 ET — Durable Goods Orders (Aug P) — capital spending
- 10:00 ET — U. Michigan Consumer Sentiment final (Sep) — household view

**Mon 2026-09-28**
- no major prints

(Next high-impact: ADP 08:15 ET Sep 30; JOLTS 10:00 ET Sep 29; GDP third / PCE 08:30 ET Sep 30. Monthly equity OPEX Friday Oct 16.)

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**2026-09-21 / recent** — Korea Zinc / Project Crucible — DoD final EA + FONSI — confirmed.
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BlueBird 14-16 production complete / possible October Falcon 9 window — inferred; no company-confirmed NET.
**~Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification window; commercial collection still Q4 2027 — estimated.
ASTS: no additional firm dated events in 30d.
TMC: no additional firm ISA / vessel / offtake dates in 30d.

## Insiders — recently reported
ASTS: Yao (CTO) 10b5-1 sale 40,000 @ ~$58.93 on 16 Sep; Gupta (COO) sale 12,000 @ ~$58.89; remaining 462,980 direct.
TMC: Hall (Director) RSU grant 72,935 on 11 Sep. No open-market TMC trades in 14d.

## Rates / FX / tape
10y ~4.94–4.95%; 2y ~4.74–4.75%; 10y–2y ~+20 bp (not inverted). USDJPY ~157.0–157.3. SPX ~7,765; IWM ~285–286; VIX ~14.9.

## What actually matters this morning
- Richmond Fed + three FOMC speakers
- Claims / New Home Sales Thursday
- Korea Zinc Crucible FONSI
- ASTS production cadence continues; no dated launch in 30d
- Low VIX / quiet calendar until later-week data
